transcript.text: Hi everyone. I'm considering an informal exchange of my first-pressing vinyl record, and Marcus has mentioned a possible trade involving a used synthesizer. Before I agree to anything, my usual practice is to hear from each person present — so if anyone has a relevant offer, comparison, compatibility note, or handoff detail, now's the time to share it. Marcus, if you could also lay out your proposed terms for the synthesizer trade, that would help me make a decision.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My exact proposal is my Korg Minilogue XD synthesizer plus $75 in cash for Lena's first-pressing vinyl record, with the exchange on Saturday at 2:00 p.m.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I should mention that Gabe, another collector who isn't here today, told me he would pay exactly $400 cash for the record and could collect it Sunday afternoon. I'm passing that along so you have it as a point of comparison, Lena.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I've tested Marcus's synthesizer and confirmed it's a 110-volt unit, so it must be used with a step-down transformer. The good news is Marcus has one available to include in the exchange.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Lena will trade her first-pressing vinyl record for Marcus's Korg Minilogue XD synthesizer plus $75 cash, with handoff on Saturday at 2:00 p.m., including a step-down transformer.
Gabe's alternative offer of $400 cash for the record, collectible Sunday afternoon, is recorded as reported by Iris for future reference.
